direction: 被塗改的紀錄，仍留下壓痕
brief:
Use case: ui-mockup / style-transfer. This is the original adult narrative horror puzzle game 灰燈寨. ART DIRECTION: administrative captivity, erased lives, tactile mending. Transform the supplied game UI reference into a highly authored contemporary psychological-horror art direction, with editorial restraint and beautiful disturbing material specificity. The reference is an EDIT TARGET: preserve its screen purpose, essential labels, control meanings, known-only information, no new mechanics.
Distinctive new visual language: uncoated ash-white carbon-copy forms and charcoal rubbing, pressure-indent marks, offset carbon ghost marks ONLY on blank margins, brittle perforation edges, quiet graphite registration ticks derived from institutional forms, irregular repair stitch only in peripheral page seams, large deliberate black negative space. One incomplete hairline boundary may stop before a corner, suggesting containment, but buttons and active targets remain exact and stable. Matte soot black #101112, paper ash #CEC6B5, offwhite #EEE6D4, graphite #3A3A37; cold faded cyan #789A9C for perception only, extremely sparse oxidized-ochre #9A7855 for selection. NO gold ornamental frames, floral corners, temple illustrations, traditional Chinese fantasy/RPG styling, generic luxury menu, glowing cyan neon or computer dashboard. Headings: large compact Traditional Chinese Ming-print character, subtly dry ink edges yet fully legible; body: clear calm typesetting, sufficient contrast. Distressed texture never touches body text or hit targets.
This is horror through stillness, withheld light, empty places and indifferent paperwork, not gore or monsters. No literal moth icons, wings across UI, eyes, skulls, blood, religious imagery, ritual talismans, cosmic symbols or premature plot reveals. World is meticulous 2D painted damp concrete, tile, cloth, black water and old institutional hardware, minimal amber light. ONE narrow ordinary light source. Do not add faces, actors or damage.
UI must stay calm and readable, one tiny world focus only, no object-wide outline. Paper notebook is non-luminous, no camera feature, objective playback or remote buttons. No health, battery, panic value, item capacity, moral score, completion % or collection count. No new subtitles or source facts. Taiwanese Traditional Chinese labels exact. 16:9 wide art, generous safe margin; beautiful film-title/editorial composition with material depth, not a wireframe.
